# Exercise 1

What is the total number of seats available on all of the planes that flew out of New York in 2013?

```{duckdb}
#| session: flights
SELECT sum(seats) 
FROM flights 
LEFT JOIN planes USING (tailnum);
```


# Exercise 2

1. For each month, which carrier had the worst mean arrival delay? Use a window function and `QUALIFY`.

   ```{duckdb}
   #| session: flights
   WITH monthly AS (
     SELECT month, carrier, avg (arr_delay) AS delay
     FROM flights
     GROUP BY ALL
   )
   SELECT month, carrier, round(delay,  2) AS delay
   FROM monthly
   QUALIFY rank() OVER (PARTITION BY  month ORDER BY delay DESC) = 1
   ORDER BY month;
   ```

2. What fraction of each carrier's flights departed more than 30 minutes late, and how does that compare to the fraction over all flights? Use a CTE.

   ```{duckdb}
   #| session: flights
   WITH overall AS (
     SELECT avg(CASE WHEN dep_delay >  30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as  overall_late
     FROM flights
   )
   SELECT carrier,
     round(avg(CASE WHEN dep_delay > 30  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 3) AS late,
     round(overall_late, 3)as  overall_late
     FROM flights CROSS JOIN overall
   GROUP BY carrier, overall_late
   ORDER BY late DESC;
   ```
